headline: Boston Scientific announces results for second quarter 2026
summary: Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE: BSX) generated net sales of $5.442 billion during the second quarter of 2026, growing 7.5 percent on a reported basis and 7.0 percent on an operational1 and organic2 basis, all compared to the prior year period.
